statement: At the pinned source revisions, the Switch 1 Joy-Con left-half protocol target uses Nintendo HID vendor 0x057e and Bluetooth product 0x2006, with controller type 0x01 in the reply to device-info subcommand 0x02; the left half is distinct from the consumer-generated combined identity 0x2008.
